text: Picked up the Aurora X2 and the sound honestly blew me away. The music is really sharp especially the mids and mounds of brawny bass. The ncv is really strong my daily commute is pretty noisy and I can barely hear it, and I like that it's not intrusive. Battery life is the thing I really wanted to be impressed with and I was. It'll go nearly 30 hours before you gotta charge. But after a few hours my ears were starting to hurt from the cushions I was using them for long stretches. Its cheap at 149 so its value I think is really good, and the app does randomly disconnect and I'd say it works 95% of the time I'd still recommend these to any friend
